name: Vilebranch Hooligans
summary: In Revantusk Village, Smith Slagtree seeks tools stolen by Vilebranch trolls. A kind-hearted gnome gave him the set after saving his life when he was a young orc.

sections.title: A Gift From a Gnome
sections.body: Vilebranch trolls took Smith Slagtree's tools when they invaded Revantusk Village. He has spares, but the stolen set came from a kind-hearted gnome who saved his life when he was a young orc. The gift means the world to Slagtree, so he asks you to recover it.

sections.title: Where the Tools Were Seen
sections.body: Markhor saw the tools near the temples of Agol'watha and Shaol'watha in the northeast of the Hinterlands. Slagtree also says to check Skulk Rock. The Vilebranch trolls there are ruthless and murderous.

faq.q: Why are these stolen tools so important to Smith Slagtree?
aliases: why does slagtree care about his tools
faq.answer: A kind-hearted gnome gave the tools to Slagtree after saving his life when he was a young orc. Slagtree has spares, but says the gifted set means the world to him.

faq.q: Who stole the tools from Revantusk Village?
faq.answer: Vilebranch trolls stole Smith Slagtree's tools during their invasion of Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Where were the missing tools taken?
faq.answer: Near the temples of Agol'watha and Shaol'watha, in the northeast of the Hinterlands, where Markhor saw them. Slagtree also points to Skulk Rock.

faq.q: Who reported seeing the tools after the raid?
faq.answer: Markhor told Smith Slagtree where the tools had been seen.
